scope: Two separate, prospectively frozen cohorts of 16 late-game roots each. Each source game was physically replayed to its historical terminal board; test trajectories start at their first recorded positive <=8 crossing in the final 256 board suffix. No source stream overlaps the previous 64 terminal-geometry records or eight direct-preview roots. These are conditional historical starts; no fresh selection or promotion.
rule: While a positive count exists, if greedy would leave zero, choose the highest actor-ranked retained alternative with a positive count. A tie uses original shortlist order. The first-only control disables the condition after its first override; the repeated player can override again.
endpoint: The first-stage observations are restricted to 256 placements after each selected root. Natural-endpoint continuation of the four ties at that cap in the second cohort is recorded below. All three policies played all 16 second-cohort roots to physical top-out. These selected roots do not establish game-wide dominance.

working_checkout.case_selection: Both registered action-changing decisions in the first cohort, first forced extinction and first safe positive-origin decision on their recurring treatment paths.
working_checkout.independent_geometry: Apply normal checked candidate placement and hyperlayer clears to each of the entire retained shortlist, then count legal CROSS origins from every full resulting board with integer shape-bottom height tests. Among preserving afterboards, select highest raw actor logit with original ID breaking ties.
interfaces: device-preparer evaluator branch with actual DevicePreparedBatch and CPU reference tensors

runtime_validation.scope: Single game, batch=1, CPU threads=1. From prepare through checked commit, device synchronized. The two_stage flag controls outer candidate preparation. Every position and mode runs once to warm before timed pass. One timed pass with other low-priority observers active. The medians do not establish a speed difference.

horizon_extension.interpretation: Four pairs previously tied at 256 continued under the original three policies. Three reached equal natural endings and the remaining pair was tied at 2048. Only natural endpoints can settle its contribution.

pairwise_mobility_weight.calculation: The increase above weight 4 required to tie each observed greedy and guard logit is weight4_logit_gap divided by the difference of their production normalized after-move mobility values. Computed in real arithmetic from the recorded FP32 scores; other shortlisted moves can win and FP32 ties can depend on ordering. No intervention applied to games.

large_weight_fixed_board_intervention.scope: Four prespecified global in-memory scalars on the pinned saved actor (4 is the deployed comparator). All 40 ordered board/target inputs, 5,028 legal shortlisted candidates from ten archived training-game replays. Retrospective danger means 512 placements or less before the historical top-out; 20 danger and 20 ordinary. No new game continuation or selection.
large_weight_fixed_board_intervention.calculation: Use actual two-stage native preparation with deployed weight-4 config, exact physical afterboard CROSS counts, and fixed production FP32 32x128 forward. Only mutate the direct scalar in memory. Candidate tapers are f(N)=log1p(min(N,16))/log(17), selected with original-order argmax ties. Report membership of top 16 for further sensitivity; pair reorders use stable candidate index ties.

large_weight_all_candidates_on_override_.scope: All two first-cohort and three second-cohort actual override boards on their registered repeated-guard trajectories, including the second trigger on the displaced 300394 path. Fixed controls and intervention weights, no endpoints or post-last-trigger rollouts.
large_weight_all_candidates_on_override_.method: Original fixed 32 x 128 CPU FP32 forward, equal retained candidate set and mask, earliest index on ties. Exact source board/stream, legal actor/guard actions, guard afterboard and original adjusted logit gap agree on every case. All weighted logits verified bitwise against independent incumbent plus scalar*(f_after-f_before); finite valid entries, -inf padding.
